EC1: severe coronary artery disease [OR], heart failure [OR], kidney failure
EC2: insulin-dependent DM (diabetes mellitus), poorly controlled type II DM
EC4: allergy [OR]/contra-indication [AND] for any drug used in the study
EC6: preoperative use of opioid drugs ([NOT] excl. codeine [OR], tramadol)
EC8: lack of co-operation, e.g. inability to use [AND] a PCA (patient controlled analgesia)-device
